scope: Real shipped presentation handlers in controlled DOM/RAF. Focus lifecycle and no audio/count side effects; no rendered pixel or physical-device claim.

results.name: Keyboard redisplay restores focus to the prior visible control on success
Automatic healthy foreground probe restores focus before hiding a focused warning
Saved control hidden after a tab change is skipped for visible player focus
Escape follows the same visible focus target when the saved control is disabled
Disconnected saved control falls back to the existing visible player
Successful redisplay does not steal focus moved to another app control
Page hiding cancels probes and does not focus an underlying inactive page
Pointer dismiss preserves an already-focused player control
